```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(jsonlite)
library(httr2)
options(HTTPUserAgent = "3MB001-course", timeout = 90)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
use_snapshot <- identical(Sys.getenv("BIOINFO_SNAPSHOT"), "true")
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
retrieved <- if (use_snapshot) "2026-11-18" else as.character(Sys.Date())
get_json <- function(url, ...) {
  req <- req_url_query(request(url), ...)
  resp_body_json(req_perform(req_retry(req, max_tries = 3)), simplifyVector = FALSE)
}
cache_csv <- function(name, fetch) {
  file <- file.path("data", paste0(name, "-", retrieved, ".csv"))
  if (file.exists(file)) return(read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  if (use_snapshot) stop("Missing snapshot: ", file)
  value <- fetch()
  write.csv(value, file, row.names = FALSE)
  value
}
```

# Question

How do tissue expression and trial records connect cytoskeletal biology to disease?

# Browser evidence

Taxol contacts β-tubulin in 1JFF; 5N69 contains omecamtiv mecarbil, an activator. Mavacamten is an inhibitor.

# Data

GTEx v8 median TPM and ClinicalTrials.gov intervention search `mavacamten`; retrieved `r retrieved`. API endpoints are recorded in the code.

```{r gtex-fetch}
genes <- params$genes
tissues <- c("Skin_Not_Sun_Exposed_Suprapubic", "Esophagus_Mucosa",
             "Muscle_Skeletal", "Heart_Left_Ventricle", "Brain_Cortex",
             "Nerve_Tibial", "Liver", "Lung")
fetch_expression <- function() {
  rows <- lapply(genes, function(gene) {
    ref <- get_json("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/reference/gene",
                    geneId = gene, datasetId = "gtex_v8")$data
    exact <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$geneSymbol, gene), ref)
    if (length(exact) != 1) stop("Ambiguous gene: ", gene)
    id <- exact[[1]]$gencodeId
    exp <- get_json("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression",
                    gencodeId = id, datasetId = "gtex_v8", itemsPerPage = 250)$data
    exp <- Filter(function(x) x$tissueSiteDetailId %in% tissues, exp)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(exp, function(x) data.frame(
      gene = gene, gencode_id = id, tissue = x$tissueSiteDetailId,
      tpm = x$median, dataset = "gtex_v8")))
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
# Parameter-specific live cache avoids reusing results for another gene set.
cache_name <- if (use_snapshot) "gtex-expression" else
  paste0("gtex-expression-", paste(sort(genes), collapse = "_"))
expression <- cache_csv(cache_name, fetch_expression)
if (!all(genes %in% expression$gene)) stop("Requested genes absent from cache")
expression <- expression[expression$gene %in% genes, ]
stopifnot(nrow(expression) == length(genes) * length(tissues))
```

```{r expression-heatmap, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
ggplot(expression, aes(tissue, gene, fill = log10(tpm + 1))) +
  geom_tile() + scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "log10(TPM + 1)") +
  labs(x = "GTEx adult tissue", y = "Gene",
       caption = paste("GTEx v8; retrieved", retrieved, "(bulk tissue medians)")) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r trials-fetch}
fetch_trials <- function() {
  token <- NULL
  rows <- list()
  repeat {
    args <- list(url = "https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies",
                 query.intr = "mavacamten", format = "json", pageSize = 100,
                 countTotal = "true")
    if (!is.null(token)) args$pageToken <- token
    result <- do.call(get_json, args)
    for (study in result$studies) {
      p <- study$protocolSection
      phase <- p$designModule$phases
      if (is.null(phase) || !length(phase)) phase <- "NOT_APPLICABLE"
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        nct_id = p$identificationModule$nctId,
        title = p$identificationModule$briefTitle,
        phases = paste(unlist(phase), collapse = ";"),
        conditions = paste(unlist(p$conditionsModule$conditions), collapse = ";"),
        status = p$statusModule$overallStatus)
    }
    token <- result$nextPageToken
    if (is.null(token)) break
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
trials <- cache_csv("mavacamten-trials", fetch_trials)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(trials$nct_id))
```

```{r trial-phase-chart}
phase_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(trials)), function(i) {
  data.frame(nct_id = trials$nct_id[i], phase = strsplit(trials$phases[i], ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
}))
phase_rows$phase[phase_rows$phase %in% c("NA", "NOT_APPLICABLE", "")] <- "Not applicable"
counts <- as.data.frame(table(phase_rows$phase))
names(counts) <- c("phase", "studies")
ggplot(counts, aes(phase, studies)) + geom_col(fill = "#a8324a") +
  labs(x = "Registered study phase", y = "Study records",
       caption = paste("ClinicalTrials.gov; intervention search mavacamten; retrieved", retrieved,
                       "— multi-phase studies count in each applicable phase")) + theme_minimal()
```

# Interpretation

The query contains `r nrow(trials)` distinct trial records. KRT14 is abundant in
skin, DES in muscle, GFAP in brain and MYH7 in the heart. Bulk RNA data mix cell
types, and registry counts describe research activity rather than efficacy.
